source: UN Comtrade, United Nations Statistics Division — public preview API
classification: HS; HS4 codes as specified in raw source rows

normalization.fitted_on: All four HS4 sector observations from 2016 through 2023; excludes held-out year

limitations: HS4 import value is a proxy for import market size, not domestic investment viability.
World-partner totals do not measure supplier concentration.
No observed employment or firm-level financial profitability is inferred.
The processed data is not yet wired into the current synthetic RL environment.
Check classification consistency, is_reported flags, and revisions before publication.
